_doc: Sương Tùng Các lineage (rules-proposals R5). Seat fits Wood, Water (unchanged). The only house under the pines allowed to write. Outer gate: pine-paper-talisman-primer (Yellow, Wood or Water). Inner gate and above: frost-pine-ward-canon (Profound, Wood first, Water). Secret arts: thorn-and-ink-verses (existing, inner gate; the ink), lantern-ward-art (elders and the head). Proposals are unpriced.

secret.note: existing (catalogue-soul-song-seal, Wood); taught as the ink of the wards

lineage.tree_route_note: The Evergreen idea (Fir Needles, Winter Green, Evergreen): the frost pine that keeps its needles; status and timer resistance for a ward-writer who must not be stopped mid-stroke.

techniques.name: Pine Paper Talisman Primer (Tùng Chỉ Phù Quyết)
techniques.concept: The outer gate's method begins with paper. A student peels birch bark, boils it with pine resin and melted frost, and presses it into sheets, drawing Wood qi from the bark and Water qi from the frost as she works. Only then is she taught a stroke. At the sixth layer she can write a plain ward that holds for a night.

arts.concept: Throws a blank sheet that sticks to a foe and slows its next art; a written sheet on the same foe deals more damage.

techniques.lore: The founder Chiêm Thư Sương taught papermaking before writing, so that her students would know what a ward is made of (V007).

techniques.name: Frost Pine Ward Canon (Sương Tùng Phù Kinh)
techniques.concept: The pavilion's canon is a talisman method. The cultivator writes her own meridians, stroke by stroke, in Wood ink on a body of Water, so that her qi moves along written paths and can be laid down on paper and lit later. In a fight she lays wards in advance: on herself and on lanterns. They go off when a foe crosses them, and each one burns a little of the paper it was written on.

arts.concept: Gains three Ward charges, with no limit on how many are held, and each held ward costs you a little linh lực each second; each time the foe fires an art, one is spent: the foe cannot evade for 1 s and takes Wood damage. In a foreseen fight, three are gained before it begins, at no cost.

arts.new: Frost on the Pine (Tùng Thượng Sương)
arts.concept: Writes a ward on you: the next hit on you is reduced and the attacker is slowed.

techniques.lore: Written down, unlike anything of the pines' own. Tùng Đào allowed it in 1060 because a ward is a tool and not a teaching (V007). The pavilion knows the line between the two is thinner than the pines think.

techniques.name: Lantern Ward Art (Hộ Đăng Quyết)
techniques.concept: The art of the ward lanterns that hang in the lake villages. A ward written on the inside of a lantern's paper holds for a whole winter, and when it is lit it keeps out cold, beasts and ice. In a fight the holder gains a Lantern charge: while it is held, the holder regenerates and resists cold, and the foe is slowed and marked.

arts.concept: Gains a Lantern charge for several seconds: while you hold it, you regenerate health and resist cold; the foe is slowed and takes more damage from wards.

techniques.lore: Made after the ice wall of 1033 flattened Nghênh Nguyệt Trấn (V006), before the pavilion existed, by the founder while she was still a ward-writer of the pines' Array Hall. Văn Hàn Đăng hangs four hundred lanterns a winter.
